alerts.title: Signed AI-compute orders; funding and delivery remain unproven
alerts.subject: Volato Group · Alignment Engine
alerts.market: NYSE American: SOAR · Class A common stock (not an ADR) · USD reporting and quote currency
alerts.whatChanged: A September 28 filing reports two four-year GPU-compute orders signed September 22, with approximately USD 1.17 billion aggregate contractual value. This is contracted future business, not recognized revenue or profit.
alerts.catalyst: A first major customer commitment for the subsidiary, with contractual deployments starting December 31, 2026 and June 30, 2027.
facts: The filed agreement covers AMD MI355X and MI455X infrastructure in Ohio.
The company reports approximately USD 133 million in contractual prepayments, including USD 40 million due after execution; receipt was not verified.
inferences: The orders could support a significant business transition if financing, equipment, power, customer acceptance and payments materialize. No undervaluation conclusion is established.
risks: Going-concern uncertainty and financing/dilution risk; June financials precede the new infrastructure business.
Customer concentration, equipment procurement, power availability and delivery/performance obligations.
Current quote, market liquidity, post-transaction capital structure and project costs are not verified.
alerts.counterevidence: The historical business lost money and used operating cash. Contract value alone does not demonstrate funded capacity, cash collection or profitable delivery.
alerts.invalidation: Reassess on missed payments or deployment milestones, unfinanceable project costs, termination, or dilution that destroys per-share economics.
alerts.nextStep: Review the filings and seek evidence of collected prepayments, committed financing and installed capacity before considering a valuation.
alerts.timing: Contract starts: December 31, 2026 and June 30, 2027; both future obligations. Research recheck by September 30, 2026 20:29 UTC.
alerts.price: Stock quote and valuation not verified at September 28, 2026 20:29 UTC (September 29, 01:59 IST). Research lead only; no actionable investment alert.
alerts.limitations: Company filings corroborate the reported agreement, not independent customer payment or operational delivery. India and US searches yielded no other sufficiently verified alert; no live bookable travel bargain was verified. Coverage is selective.

stock.listingType: Class A common stock; not ADR
stock.observedQuoteAndTime: Not verified at 2026-09-28T20:29:00Z; exchange page did not expose a timestamped quote.
stock.valuationBasis: Not verified. No current price, fully diluted share count or enterprise-value multiple established; USD 1.17 billion is contract value, not equity valuation.
stock.financialPeriod: Quarter and six months ended June 30, 2026; 10-Q filed August 14, 2026. Historical, before the new infrastructure orders.
stock.revenueAndProfit: Q2 revenue USD 0.965 million; net loss USD 2.051 million. Six-month revenue USD 1.967 million; net loss USD 4.685 million.
stock.cashFlow: Six-month net operating cash outflow USD 2.855 million; net financing inflow USD 6.953 million.
stock.balanceSheetDilutionLiquidity: June 30 cash approximately USD 8.4 million; liabilities USD 10.072 million. The 10-Q raises substantial going-concern doubt. Equity financing occurred; current post-transaction dilution and trading liquidity remain unverified.

alerts.title: A new precision-component operation in Michigan
alerts.subject: Salient Motion · Saginaw Precision
alerts.market: Business sourcing research; no listed equity assessed
alerts.whatChanged: Salient Motion announced a division making precision ball screws and roller screws in Saginaw, Michigan.
alerts.catalyst: Expansion of domestic motion-control component manufacturing.
facts: The company announced the division on 28 September 2026.
Its official job board listed a mechanical-engineering role in Saginaw at the check time.
An official supplier page provides a quality manual and commercial terms.
inferences: Qualified manufacturing-service suppliers could investigate purchasing needs. No open procurement requirement was verified.
risks: Supplier qualification and ramp execution are uncertain.
Bringing production in-house could reduce outside sourcing.
Commercial prices, orders and production economics were not verified.
alerts.counterevidence: The division is vertically integrated. Factory expansion does not establish demand for external suppliers.
alerts.invalidation: Stop pursuing this lead if no external purchasing need exists or qualification cannot be met economically.
alerts.nextStep: Read the official supplier manual and confirm an actual purchasing need before spending.
alerts.timing: 2027 capacity is a company target, not demonstrated output. No application deadline was published.
alerts.price: Commercial price not disclosed. No stock quote or valuation assessed.
alerts.limitations: Primary company disclosures and recruitment listings establish an announcement and hiring activity, not independently verified output, revenue or profit.
